title: Since the last letter, 2 new photos and a family answer

turns.content: Album Out Loud, photos since the last letter for Grandpa, album Grandpa's 80th birthday.

Album Out Loud setup. Reply go, or change any line.
1. Album or photo folder: Grandpa's 80th birthday
2. For: Grandpa, in English
3. Detail: brief, one AI sentence per photo. Say rich for up to three sentences per photo.
4. Photos: 6, at most 10
5. Family notes signed by: the family
6. Letter: since the last letter

I read only this album and your earlier letters, ask the photo expert of the NAS to describe the photos, change nothing in Photos, and save one text file after you approve. Names come only from your notes. The time per photo depends on the NAS model and has not been measured yet. You read the whole letter, say save, then confirm once more if Uliya asks.

delegate --target photo-agent --instruction 'Read only. A ’ may be a straight apostrophe; try both. Write every straight apostrophe in returned names, paths and lines, and in answer lines, as ’. Use the vision-vlm action of the NAS without setting another model value, and send no photo to another service; if vision-vlm is not available, return failed. For each photo, run vision-vlm once with temperature 0.2, max tokens 90 and this prompt, copied exactly. Prompt begins: You write the spoken description of one family photo for a listener who is blind. Step 1, privacy: if the photo shows an ID card, a bank card, a medical paper, a medical scene, an injury, a bare body, a baby or child who is not fully dressed, such as in a bath, or a phone or computer screen with messages or personal data, write only Not described: and a reason of at most 4 words in English, and nothing else. Step 2, otherwise write exactly two lines and nothing more. Line 1: one sentence in English of 8 to 12 words that starts with the main subject and says what is happening. Line 2: Words: and then the large, clear text that is a main part of the photo, such as a sign, a banner, writing on a cake or a printed shirt, copied letter by letter in its own language and spelling, at most 25 words, or Words: none. Leave out small print, bottle and food labels, logos, watermarks, number plates and any number longer than 4 digits, and never translate. For people, give the number up to 5, otherwise say a group, call each one a baby, a child or an adult, never man, woman, boy, girl, he or she, and give their main visible action. In a language with gendered words, use the same form for every adult whatever they look like, such as un adulto in Spanish. Never mention a name, ethnicity, skin, body, looks, age in years, health, disability or religion, and never guess who someone is, how they are related, such as a family or a couple, or what they feel. If the figures are statues, toys, drawings or pictures, say so first, such as a bronze statue of two children. Name an event only when clear objects show it, such as candles on a cake or graduation gowns. If the photo is black and white or an old print, begin Line 1 with the words In black and white or An old print, said in English, never with this photo shows. If the whole photo is too dark or too blurred to see, Line 1 says only that, in English, Line 2 is Words: none, and you guess nothing. Never begin with this photo shows, the image or a picture of. Keep the labels Line 1, Line 2, Words, none and Not described in English. Use no quotation marks, no apostrophes and, in English, no contractions. Prompt ends. If the answer has a Words line, with or without a Line 2 or Line 3 label, that is not Words: none, also run vision-ocr on that photo. Return one record per photo in order: P number, every answer line word for word, and the vision-ocr result or none. If vision-vlm fails on a photo, return its P number, Not described and why. Never describe a photo yourself. Values: photos = P1 /volume1/Photos/2026/Grandpa’s 80th birthday/IMG_4133.jpg; P2 /volume1/Photos/2026/Grandpa’s 80th birthday/IMG_4135.jpg.'
